title: Is This Guy Who Uses AI To Run His Fantasy Football Team The Biggest Loser In The World?
key_facts: Nic Carter, a venture capitalist focused on finance and blockchains, boasted this week that an AI agent runs his fantasy football team.
Per Carter, the AI drafts players, adds and drops free agents and decides weekly starters.
The Defector writer argues this is autodraft with extra steps, using stat projections already in the fantasy app.
The writer notes some of Carter's starters had weak early weeks before Week 4.
Carter did not reply to Defector's email asking for his record.
A matchup screenshot posted by his opponent leads the writer to say the team is 1-3.
quote_evidence: So this weird, off-putting man's AI-managed fantasy team is now 1-3.
To get to the bottom of this, I emailed Carter, asking for his team's record, but he has yet to respond.
why_it_matters_hint: A light example of handing a hobby task to an AI agent, judged by the results.
event_date: Week 4 of the NFL season, early Oct 2026.
notes: Opinion column with personal insults of Carter, not repeated. The 1-3 record rests on the writer's reading of one opponent's screenshot.
